messages.subject: For Germán Morales | Sustainability, corporate affairs and mining-sector stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Valler,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Germán Morales, President, Australia Pacific and Sustainability.

Orica's structure brings sustainability, corporate affairs and operating leadership together under one executive mandate. That integrated model closely matches my own experience from inside a major mining operation, where stakeholder outcomes and operating performance are tightly connected.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines ESG, government and regulatory relations, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery infrastructure and coordinated carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side perspective might support Orica's sustainability, corporate-affairs, stakeholder or mining-sector growth priorities, including opportunities across Latin America and other international markets. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
